## Activity

This report covers activity at Central Eye Clinic for April 2023. The clinic team completed 189 captures during the month. Activity was delivered through the planned session schedule, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported capture volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Graders marked 4 sets ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1 of all captures. This indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable images remain relevant to ongoing quality monitoring. The result should be considered alongside the overall activity level and the grading outcomes for the month.

## Grading

A total of 34 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3. This provides a summary measure of the time between image submission and the grading outcome. Overall, the site maintained planned operational activity during April 2023, with image-quality and grading results recorded for review through routine service monitoring.
